authority.label: Greek Port State Control authority / Paris MoU inspection system

proposition.statement: Thirteen deficiencies were found and all thirteen were grounds for detention.

source_refs.locator: detained in Psakhna on 18 July 2026; 13 deficiencies; all grounds for detention

legal_relevance.statement: Directive 2009/16/EC Article 19 and Annex X govern detention where inspection establishes sufficiently serious or clearly hazardous deficiencies.

forbidden_inferences: The finding is a textual mutation of Directive 2009/16/EC.
The number 13 converts the case into an authoritative metric observation.
The finding contract owns the ship's full enforcement or refusal-of-access lifecycle.
